journey.title: Choose 'No symptoms' after ticking symptoms with the keyboard
journey.goal: Ticking the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' answer clears the symptoms ticked earlier

functionalJourney.title: Tick two symptoms with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Both ticked symptoms are submitted and no-symptoms stays clear

guards.title: Choose 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method
guards.goal: The exclusive answer in a shared-name group clears the method ticked earlier

plan.root_cause: The exclusive checkbox uses an empty string value for the data-checkbox-exclusive attribute (data-checkbox-exclusive=""), which the NHSUK checkboxes module may not recognize as a boolean flag, preventing the mutual-exclusion behavior that clears other checkboxes in the group when the exclusive option is selected.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the attribute to a boolean presence (no value) to match the expected markup, allowing the module to detect the exclusive flag and clear other checkboxes in the group.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive="" data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users will now be able to select the “No, I do not have any of these symptoms” option and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, meeting the exclusive choice behavior and preserving form data integrity.
functional_risks: If any custom script depends on the attribute having an empty string value, it may need updating.
Ensure the change does not affect visual styling or form validation.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting the exclusive option via mouse or keyboard clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes.
Verify that selecting a symptom after the exclusive option clears the exclusive option (if that behavior is also required).
Confirm that form submission reflects the correct values for symptoms[none] and symptom checkboxes.
Ensure the contact checkboxes exclusive behavior remains unchanged.

plan.repair_strategy: Change data-checkbox-exclusive="" to data-checkbox-exclusive (boolean attribute) to match the pattern used by the working 'Do not contact me' checkbox, enabling the mutual-exclusion behavior.

plan.root_cause: The exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox includes data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms" alongside data-checkbox-exclusive, unlike the working 'Do not contact me' checkbox which has only data-checkbox-exclusive. This likely causes the NHSUK checkboxes module to treat the exclusive option as a regular group member rather than the exclusive control, preventing it from clearing other symptom checkboxes when selected.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the data-checkbox-exclusive-group attribute from the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox so only the symptom checkboxes carry the group marker, matching the pattern used by the working contact checkboxes.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can select 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, meeting exclusive choice behavior and preserving form data integrity.
functional_risks: If the module relies on the exclusive checkbox having the group attribute for group identification, this could break the behavior.
Ensure the change does not affect visual styling or form validation.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting the exclusive option via mouse or keyboard clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes.
Verify that selecting a symptom after the exclusive option clears the exclusive option.
Confirm that form submission reflects the correct values for symptoms[none] and symptom checkboxes.
Ensure the contact checkboxes exclusive behavior remains unchanged.
